title: Append-only convention correction fixes the R-176 Fourier reading without advancing the production owner
question: Which Fourier convention is authoritative for the R-176 roots when its frozen manifest string disagrees with the executable and the A1 spectral backend?
method: Re-run the registered primary, independent, and integrated F_ref root-frequency crosswalk under the restored repository Python runtime.
Compare the frozen R-176 manifest, the R-174 production-cylinder convention, the R-176 executable roots, and the A1 spectral step without editing any historical authority.
Freeze 2*pi/L as the canonical executable convention in a new append-only strategy record and preserve the stale m*pi/L string as an explicit mismatch.
Apply hostile checks against relabelling the norm-square-3 F_ref shell as the R-176 roots and against promoting a convention choice to heat-root incidence or a q-ledger.
finding: The crosswalk passes primary 23/23, independent 16/16, and integrated 19/19. The executable and A1 convention is 2*pi/L, giving roots with norm-squares 1 and 4. The F_ref completed-square minimum is q_*^2/(2*pi/16)^2 = 2.999999999993102473641602178113512365467, so its nearest side-16 shell has norm-square 3 and is not the R-176 pair.
decision_reason: Use 2*pi/L for all future crosswalks and retain the old R-176 manifest string unchanged as a stale record. This resolves the convention ambiguity without silently mutating an authority or identifying the F_ref shell with the production roots.
boundary: This is a T0 claim-nonbearing convention prerequisite. It does not supply the canonical nonlinear production mobility, heat_root_incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, or one-use nonnegative q-ledger. R-192 therefore remains open at heat_root_incidence; no A13, T-050, Sector-A, Pre-A, OS/KMS, continuum, thermodynamic, physical-empty, or mass-gap conclusion follows.
next_action: Use the frozen 2*pi/L convention only in a new same-parent candidate that derives heat_root_incidence and every remaining R-192 slot; otherwise retain the first-missing owner stop.
